This high-end designer retreat has been recently renovated throughout, blending modern sophistication with the relaxed charm of seaside living. Nestled in a prime location, between Alys & Rosemary Beach to the East and The Big Chill & Seaside to the West, this property offers the perfect fusion of warmth, style, and comfort. As you step through the front door, you are greeted by an inviting open concept living space. The interior has been professionally decorated by a popular Nashville design team, and showcases a hip and trendy modern space that effortlessly captures the essence of beachside chic. Earth tones dominate the color palette, creating a warm and calming ambiance throughout the home. The living room is a haven of comfort, featuring plush high-end furnishings and contemporary décor that invite you to unwind after a day of beach activities. Large windows frame the spacious screened in porch, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. The kitchen is a chef’s delight, boasting stainless steel appliances, sleek countertops and, high-end cookware rarely seen in a rental property. In addition, you will enjoy a large assortment of herbs, spices, and cooking oils, all complimentary for your use. Whether you’re preparing a casual beachside picnic or a gourmet feast, this kitchen is equipped to meet all your culinary needs. The bedrooms are thoughtfully designed with a modern aesthetic and furnished for optimal relaxation. Each bedroom enjoys its own streaming TV and ensuite bathroom to further indulge in the luxury of your private retreat. Step outside to the expansive screened - in porch, where you can enjoy coffee or cocktails, alfresco dining, or simply savor the ocean breeze. Steps from the screened in porch is the resort style, zero entry swimming pool that is enjoyed by many of our guests in the Magnolia community. As if this wasn’t enough, this showcase property offers a 6-seater street legal golf cart and 4 adult bikes so you can explore our beautiful paradise any way you please. The Maine Squeeze not only offers a stylish retreat with a decided island feel, but also a lifestyle centered around an easy-going coastal vibe. This home is a rare gem which seamlessly combines modern living with the timeless allure of the sea. Don’t miss the opportunity to make this coastal haven your vacation home! HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Steps from resort style pool (heated depending on ambient nightly temperatures) - Community green space (near the pool) for kids and pets to play BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by a local vendor; information provided upon request after booking TRANSPORTATION - Bikes are a popular way to explore! 4 are included with this property. - A 6 seater Golf Cart is included complimentary with this property. Please note - operators of the golf cart must be 25 years of age with a valid drivers license. Signed waiver and proof of insurance required. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8) - Primary Suite, First Floor - King bed, private bathroom with walk-in shower - King Bedroom 2, Second Floor - King bed, private bathroom with walk in shower - Bunk Room, Second Floor - 2 twin bunk beds, private bathroom with shower/tub combo FEATURES -30A – 3 Bedroom / 3.5 Bathroom House - Professionally decorated - new furnishings - Sleeps 8 (King, King, 2 Twin/Twin bunks) - Golf Cart - 4 Adult bikes - Huge Screened Porch - Large Open Floor Plan - Well Appointed Kitchen - Full Size Refrigerator - Full Size Stove/Oven - Ice Maker - Full Size Washer & Dryer - TV in Living Room & Bedrooms - Complimentary Wi-Fi - Use of Owners 6 Beach Chairs and 4 Beach Towels - Outdoor Shower - Parking for 2 cars in driveway and 1 along street - Large Resort Style Community Pool - Easy walk or golf cart ride to the beach; neighborhood is immediately across 30A from the beach access - 18 Mile Bike Path Along 30ANotesA Note on Shared Amenities: Please keep in mind that these spaces are operated by the HOA. Because of this, they are subject to seasonal availability—common seasonal closures may include April-May and Sept-Nov—and we can't be held responsible for unexpected closures or repairs. If you are booking specifically for a shared amenity, please feel free to reach out with any questions in advance!
